content.short: DAOLama is a TON NFT lending protocol that lets users borrow TON against supported NFT collateral.
content.description: DAOLama is an NFT lending protocol built for TON collections. Its public site describes a direct borrowing workflow where users can receive TON liquidity against supported NFTs instead of selling those assets outright. The product is useful for collectors who want short-term liquidity, for lenders looking at NFT-backed exposure, and for TON NFT projects that need a lending market around their collections. It is part of the TON NFT tooling layer because it turns collectible ownership into a usable collateral position.
